title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode4 The Ones Close to Us

meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Ones Close to Us
meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
Aside from some tiny mistakes, I thought that was a good run.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
We got Shiho's seal of approval!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't get ahead of yourself...
But this seems like a good place to stop. Why don't we take a break here before we go back and start making fixes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, can you tell us about the work research shadowing program you told us about the other day?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How was it?! Did you have fun?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and we learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Ichika, Honami, you two went to visit a company that produces music videos and commercials, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since we'll likely be shooting more videos in the future. We thought it'd be good for us to learn more about the production process.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: On the day of our shadowing, we got to edit an actual music video. I was astonished by how glamorous it looked in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know we've already shot a couple ourselves, but it was fun to learn about the tricks professionals use to give videos an impactful punch.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. It sounds like you two had a wonderful experience.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How about you two, Saki, Shiho? Which company did you visit?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We visited a company that plans and operates all sorts of events!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only did we get to see how they run things, we even got to plan our own event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, that sounds super fun!
What kind of event did you guys get to plan?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't talk much about it since it was based on a real business deal, but it was a product promotion event for a famous stationery company.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our event involved having the guests make message cards for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, message cards?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We thought it'd be the perfect way for people to thank those they care about most during White Day!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not only does it help promote their products, it also follows their mission statement of helping people send their thoughts to others.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It gets even better. The company just happened to be planning a really similar event...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we get to help them run things as part-timers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow, really?
You're getting actual work experience? That's pretty incredible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know you'll do a great job.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! We'll do our very best!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Telling others how you feel through message cards, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's such a great idea!
What if we also tried doing that, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We? As in us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Well, obviously!
I feel like writing some now, because there's just so much I wanna tell all of you♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. You're so pure, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, don't treat me like a little kid!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not the only one who's gonna make cards. You and everyone else are too, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I know.
I promise to write you a nice message, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're right, it might be fun to make them together.
Some things are hard to say outside of these sorts of opportunities.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Like how we might start taking each other for granted since we're together all the time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example, MEIKO always does a good job of keeping us focused during practices, and Luka's subtly but constantly looking out for us...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, does that mean you'd like me to pat your head as well?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's not what I meant.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see. This does seem like a good opportunity to show just how much we appreciate each other.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And writing a message would be easier than telling someone else directly...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Thanking others for the things they do...
The things you've taken for granted. Wouldn't that kind of event just be amazing?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I know it's a product promotion event, but I wanna do everything I can to help the guests show their appreciation for those they care about the most...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Can I tag along when you two go help out with that event, Sakki?! I wanna see what it's like!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! We can check it out together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just make sure you don't get seen by the guests or staff, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No problem!
bgm_area00004
A few weeks later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Snippy, snippy, paste, paste...
Sparkly and glittery☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, you seem to be in a good mood today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you still appear to have plenty of energy despite us just finishing practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really excited because we get to help out with that event soon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, this would be the White Day event you mentioned a while back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's gonna be all about showing appreciation for those you care about the most by writing message cards to them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're going to have the guests choose the card they like the most, and decorate them using masking tape and stickers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're even gonna have lots of other decorations available. That means they'll get to create one-of-a-kind cards♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That sounds fun!
I'd love to see how they turn out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... The one I made for practice should be in my pocket... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, what a fun-looking card.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ I used a ton of masking tape to make this one!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
A bouquet pops up when you open it?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You can make pop-up cards?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! You can even decorate the flowers using stickers and stamps!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, making these could be kinda fun...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What a fun and exciting way to show your appreciation for others!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It really is♪
I'd probably sleep like a baby if I set this next to my pillow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, a fluffy card that feels like a pillow could also be really good!
